expert_input_shape.description: 168 hours (7 days) of historical hourly electricity load observations fed to the 3 forecasting experts

context_buffer_shape.description: 192 hours (8 days) of historical load observations fed to the context extractor to enable weekly lag-168 profile comparison [t-191:t-168] vs [t-23:t]

expert_2_causal_conv.architecture: Dilated Causal TCN (5 residual blocks, c=34, k=4, dilations 1,2,4,8,16)

expert_3_patch_linear.architecture: Patch-based temporal linear model (patch_len=24, stride=12, P=13, embed=48)

expert_1.name: GatedRecurrentExpert
expert_1.inductive_bias: Continuous chronological autoregressive memory and sequential dependency tracking

expert_2.name: MultiScaleCausalTCNExpert
expert_2.type: Dilated Causal TCN with Residual Connections
expert_2.inductive_bias: Multi-scale hierarchical temporal feature extraction with strictly causal receptive field covering 187 hours (>168h)

expert_3.name: PatchTemporalExpert
expert_3.inductive_bias: Sub-series patch tokenization preserving local diurnal shape while modeling inter-patch global relationships without step-by-step decay. Note: Candidate status; subject to empirical validation in Phase 3

type_a_observable_context.description: Features derived exclusively from historical load observations up to origin t

type_b_post_forecast_error_feedback.description: Features evaluating past completed forecast cycles against observed actuals

features.name: recent_baseline_mae
features.formula: MAE of completed 24h cycle [t-23:t] from expanding Ridge baseline

type_c_forecast_difficulty.description: Inference-time consensus metrics derived from candidate expert forecasts before gating (gradient-detached)

forecast_aware_routing.detachment_guarantee: D_t is detached from autograd to prevent experts from manipulating routing gradients

temperature.role: Controls Softmax sharpness; proposed specification value, not an empirically proven optimum. Does NOT guarantee de-collapse.
temperature.validation_tuning_protocol: Evaluate tau in {0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0} strictly on validation MSE. Never use test set.

router.routing_type: Global scalar routing (w in R^3) primary; Horizon-Aware (w in R^[24, 3]) as controlled ablation

losses.primary_fused_loss: MSE on standardized targets: (1/24) * sum_{h=1}^24 (y_hat_h - y_h)^2

auxiliary_expert_loss.normalization: Mean across the 3 experts: (1/3) * sum_{i=1}^3 L_expert_i
auxiliary_expert_loss.purpose: Encourages independent forecasting competence of every expert, reducing the risk of destructive co-adaptation

entropy_regularization.purpose: Penalizes high entropy (diffuse/uniform distributions), encouraging lower routing entropy / more concentrated expert weighting. Does NOT guarantee dynamic routing.

losses.total_objective: L_total = L_fused + 0.15 * L_expert_aux + 0.001 * H(w) = L_fused + 0.15 * (1/3) * sum_{i=1}^3 L_expert_i + 0.001 * H(w)

statistical_blocks.notes: Stride-24 sampling yields 54 evaluation points; exactly 53 complete non-overlapping 24h episodes fit within 1294 test steps
